question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets, and what read-only sources, scopes, redaction, retention, export, and command-execution boundaries are acceptable for them?
rationale: The request is aligned with dashboard ergonomics, but it exposes operational logs and command output through a new UI surface and overlaps an open binding/security design where `command:` execution is deliberately deferred.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the dashboard substrate plus stream/log-source contract first, then implement the widgets against approved read-only contracts.

options.title: Allow A Narrow Read-Only Widget Slice
options.body: Permit a focused PR that only consumes existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded terminal or task output, with no new command execution binding.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets or a plugin API extension makes this safe outside core.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the dashboard substrate plus stream/log-source contract first, then implement the widgets against approved read-only contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans product direction for bundled dashboard UI and the plugin-tab seam he recently introduced in the merged Logbook work.
